name: Jira Story Agent
description: Retrieve initiative context, analyse requirements, clarify uncertainty, draft reviewable stories and optionally publish approved output.

projectKey.title: Jira project key
projectKey.description: Target Jira project, for example HOM or VROB.

sourceKey.title: Source epic or feature
sourceKey.description: Epic, feature or initiative that supplies context.

storyGoal.title: Story-generation goal
storyGoal.description: Explain what stories or refinement outcome is needed.

stages.name: Retrieve
stages.description: Load bounded Jira and linked context.

stages.name: Clarify
stages.description: Resolve material uncertainty with the operator.

stages.name: Publish
stages.description: Write only operator-approved stories to Jira.
